description: Ask a human for permission before doing something risky. Call this BEFORE the action, and only proceed when the result has proceed=true. The risk is scored from the action name (and your category, if it is riskier). A matching rule auto-approves low/medium risk actions; otherwise the human is asked directly in their client, or the request waits for them to decide with the CLI — then poll check_status.

action.description: The action you want to take, as a short verb_noun name (e.g. "delete_user", "send_email", "deploy_production")

category.description: Optional category. It can only RAISE the risk inferred from the action name, never lower it.

context.description: Why the action is needed, in one or two sentences, for the human deciding

params.description: The parameters you would act with, shown to the human (e.g. { "userId": "123", "estimatedCost": 50 }). estimatedCost raises the risk score.

wait.description: Ask the human now and wait for the answer, when the client supports it (default true). False returns at once with a pending request.

name: request_approval
